package procs

c_proc :: proc "c" (x: i32) -> i32 { return x }
inline_call :: proc() { #force_inline c_proc(1); #force_no_inline c_proc(2) }
lit_inline :: #force_inline proc() {}
ok_proc :: proc() -> (int, bool) #optional_ok { return 0, true }
named :: proc(a: int, b := 2) -> (sum: int, ok: bool) { return }
variadic :: proc(prefix: string, args: ..any) {}
c_variadic :: proc "c" (fmt: cstring, #c_vararg args: ..any) {}
flags :: proc(#any_int n: int, #by_ptr p: Big, #no_alias q: ^int, using s: S) {}
poly :: proc(x: $T, $N: int) -> [N]T { return {} }
spec :: proc($T: typeid/[]$E, v: T) -> E where size_of(E) > 1 { return v[0] }
group :: proc{ poly, spec }
Callback :: #type proc(data: rawptr) -> bool
never :: proc() -> ! { for {} }
nested :: proc() {
    inner :: proc(x: int) -> int { return x * 2 }
    _ = inner(1)
}
bare :: proc() ---
